MOVIE ARCHITECTURE — CURRENT CONSENSUS AND GATES (corrected 2026-08-30 13:02Z)

CANONICAL LANDED BASIS
- Landed plan: docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md at hash b12f79c... until a reviewed successor lands.
- One shared narrative ontology for text and movies. Movie work adds evidence, clocks, tracks, and acquisition below the shared graph.
- Raw media evidence -> persistent modality observations/features -> joined proposals and critic findings -> deterministic resolution -> shared narrative graph.
- Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. Providers propose only. Fully automatic means unresolved, alternative, unsupported, partial, and failed states are first-class; no human correction is required to finish a production build.

DURABLE DOCUMENTATION AWAITING CHIEF LANDING
- Component-admission ledger cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H, commit f203b783, exact one-path blob eb3caa99: both reviews approve; sole blocker is chief authorization/landing. This lands documentation only and admits no asset, package, model, runtime, or court.
- Final D2 time and timed-transcript contract cand-1EFRM8SF43RHZ35B8NZYXCEWV7, commit c9414dbc over current main c8ffe86, exactly two paths with hashes notes f6edf74c... and plan 8bc0aa60...: exact-byte and first formal review approve; scout formal review remains. Chief must then reconcile stale already-merged ancestor candidate records, authorize, gate, and land. V6 cand-38WBV... is formally superseded.

D2 SETTLED CONTENT
- Presentation is an edition playback axis, not a native picture clock.
- PTS and DTS are independent optional coordinates; zero duration is unknown, never a sentinel.
- Preserve signed ticks, origins, epochs, wrap/reset/discontinuity, gaps, and repeated occurrences.
- Mapping relations have stable identity distinct from derivation receipts; reverse maps may be conditional or set-valued.
- Quantized/enclosing/refused mappings are typed; arithmetic or quantization refusal is distinct from gap, outside-domain, no-correspondence, ambiguity, and missing evidence. Tolerance is not equality.
- Legacy AudioSpan/TranscriptTurn.audio remains a text-first millisecond overlay. It cannot become media EvidenceSupport without explicit local-axis binding and checked edition mapping; absent, explicit legacy-empty, packet-duration-unknown, and refusal remain distinct.

P1 BASEBALL DIAGNOSTIC — ESTIMAND ACCEPTED, STAGE NOT COMPLETE
- v3 estimand accepted by independent review at post-01M19B15C4F4Q3E4VYP4Z05P87 and ready for chief promotion into a bounded court/integration parent. Promotion does not complete the real-transcript P1 vertical.
- Eligibility is outcome-independent. Y_sv is posterior probability of any predeclared faithful or source-anchored distorted visit. Omission is 1-Y_sv only for eligible participant-by-situation cells; missing evidence is not omission. Revisitation is separate.
- Promotion must spell Accessibility_v, emit typed InsufficientSupport/NotEstimated below frozen support, and derive N_sv from the same admitted visit predicate as Y_sv.

OWNER-ONLY ACTIONS WITHIN DOCUMENTATION-ONLY B0
- Owner actions are a necessary subset, not B0 closure: pyannote gated terms; MF2 NC-SA benchmark-use decision; Sherlock exact source and artifact-level rights clarification including blank pinned metadata, unlicensed workbook repository, and separately governed BBC episode; FilmFestival edition, omitted-film, companion-repository, participant-content, and REB basis; and human recall-corpus REB/redistribution.
- MF2 approval would govern the NC-SA benchmark only, not underlying film or subtitle rights.
- B0 separately still owes exact source/component dispositions, two-run timebase repair, and aggregate-only fixtures.
- No restricted download, terms acceptance, participant prose, episode video, or source-corpus admission is authorized.

CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY
- Reusable now: word/token traversal and windows; feature tracks, reducers, derivations, sidecars, boundaries; proposals/critics/deterministic resolution; NarrativeCompilation; shared graph/hierarchy/trajectory; renderer-neutral Atlas/Codex packets.
- Existing AudioSpan/TranscriptTurn.audio is only a millisecond transcript overlay.
- Missing: SourceBundle, edition-aware PresentationAxis/MediaAtlas, multimodal evidence anchors, timed-language lattice, audiovisual tracks, worker schemas, and FFmpeg/PySceneDetect runtime.

STAGED ORDER — NOT AUTHORIZATION
1. Independently complete P1 and close B0.
2. C1: provider-free substrate, clock/evidence contracts, text and timed-transcript conformance.
3. D0/D1: narrow read-only source adapter and cross-module seam migration.
4. E0: separately authorized minimal film plus real-recall question.
5. Only then broaden acquisition workers and scientific contrasts.
- F0/F1/F2 are evidence tiers inside separately authorized courts, not implementation stages and not permission to skip stages.
- No exact lawful source-film plus human-recall F2 pair is admitted.
- A future acquisition court should use project-authored F0 first. A BBB F1 excerpt is only eligible after exact file/excerpt hashes, CC BY 3.0 attribution, and derivation/admission records; FFmpeg requires a realized exact preferably-LGPL-only configuration with codec, patent, native-dependency, and digest closure; PySceneDetect requires an exact learned-checkpoint-free ContentDetector runtime. None of these is admitted or authorized yet.

SCIENTIFIC AND OUTPUT CONTRACT
- SourceFrozen validation and predeclared transcript-only, visual-only, audio-only, full late-fusion, and one-shot contrasts precede claims.
- Movie packets expose source/media availability, edition/native/story-world/recall/scanner coordinates, and checked mappings. Preview code may seek only through checked mappings; it may not infer missing synchronization.
